title: Introduction to AI Agents
description:
AI Agents Fundamentals — understand how agents are different from LLMs, when to use workflows vs AI agents, and build a solid foundation before going deeper.

What You'll Learn

  • What are AI Agents?
  • Workflows vs AI Agents
  • Going beyond chatbot
  • From Prompt to Context Engineering
  • Agent workflow patterns
  • Test your knowledge with the AI Agents quiz

Who Is This Course For?

  • Professionals new to AI agents who want foundational understanding
  • Anyone curious about how agents differ from chatbots and LLM workflows
  • Learners ready to understand agent patterns before building more advanced solutions
instructorBio: Ava is Approachable's virtual assistant, guiding learners through practical AI workflows.

faqs.question: Do I need prior AI experience?
faqs.answer: No prior experience is needed. The course is beginner friendly and covers AI agent fundamentals from the ground up.

faqs.question: What is the difference between workflows and AI agents?
faqs.answer: Workflows follow predefined steps, while AI agents can reason, use tools, and make decisions autonomously. This course explains both and when to use each.
